changes.before: A side pane for Claude Code beside your chat: what jevmem recalled for this prompt, what its guard decided, and what the last turn saved, with why, wrong and forget buttons. Reads three local files in .jevmem/ and runs the jevmem command; sends nothing anywhere. Needs the jevmem CLI and a project that is turned on.
